# PyMockserver

> Simple, fast mock server implemented in Python with FastAPI. It exposes a control
> API (`/mockserver`) to register fake ("mocked") HTTP responses, then serves those
> mocks back on any other method/path/query combination that matches. Mocks live in
> memory only (cleared on restart) unless preloaded from fixture files on startup.

Key facts an LLM/agent should know before using or modifying this repo:
- Control endpoints: `POST /mockserver` (create), `GET /mockserver` (list), `DELETE /mockserver` (delete by request signature), `DELETE /mockserver/reset` (delete all), `GET /_meta/health` (liveness/readiness). Every other path/method is matched against registered mocks.
- Matching key is `method + path + queryStringParameters` (exact match); several mocks can be queued for the same key and are tried in registration order, disambiguated by optional `headers`/`body` (`match_body_mode`: `exact` or `partially`) matching.
- `remainingTimes` (`-1` = unlimited) decrements on every match and removes the mock once exhausted; `delay` (ms) delays the response via `asyncio.sleep`.
- Requires Python >= 3.14, dependency management via `uv`, package manager config in `pyproject.toml`.
- Shipped only as a Docker image (see `Dockerfile`, `start.sh`), deployed via the Helm chart in `helm/pymockserver`.
- Versioning/releases are automated with Commitizen (conventional commits) and GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/bumpversion.yml`, `release.yml`, `test.yaml`).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/kudlatyamroth/pymockserver/blob/master/README.md): Full documentation - API reference, request/response matching rules, request/response option tables, fixtures, architecture, environment variables, running locally, development and Docker/Helm usage.
- [openapi.json](https://github.com/kudlatyamroth/pymockserver/blob/master/openapi.json): Committed OpenAPI schema for the control API (also served live at `/openapi.json`, with Swagger UI at `/docs`).
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/kudlatyamroth/pymockserver/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): Version history generated by Commitizen from conventional commits.

## Code

- [pymockserver/](https://github.com/kudlatyamroth/pymockserver/tree/master/pymockserver): Application source (domain models, adapters, routes/main app).
- [tests/](https://github.com/kudlatyamroth/pymockserver/tree/master/tests): Test suite (pytest).
- [helm/pymockserver/](https://github.com/kudlatyamroth/pymockserver/tree/master/helm/pymockserver): Helm chart for deployment (values, health probe wiring, fixture loading on start).

## Optional

- [Dockerfile](https://github.com/kudlatyamroth/pymockserver/blob/master/Dockerfile): Docker image build definition.
- [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/kudlatyamroth/pymockserver/blob/master/pyproject.toml): Dependencies, ruff/ty lint-type config, Commitizen config.
